text: The Nimbus 3 router supports a maximum of 64 concurrent wireless clients per radio.
The Nimbus 3 router has 4 gigabit Ethernet LAN ports and 1 WAN port.
The Nimbus 3 router retails for 149 dollars in the United States.
The Nimbus 3 router weighs 410 grams without the power adapter.
The Nimbus 3 router ships with a 2 year limited hardware warranty.
The Nimbus 3 router is certified for Wi-Fi 6 and operates on the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands.
The Nimbus 3 router was released in March 2024.
The Nimbus 3 router is available in graphite and ivory finishes.
The older Nimbus 2 router supports up to 32 concurrent wireless clients per radio.
The Nimbus 2 router has 2 gigabit Ethernet LAN ports and 1 WAN port.
The Nimbus 2 router retails for 99 dollars.
The Nimbus 2 router reached end of sale in January 2025 and receives security updates until January 2027.
The Nimbus 2 router is certified for Wi-Fi 5 only.
A Nimbus mesh network can contain at most 12 nodes including the primary router.
Nimbus mesh nodes use a dedicated 5 GHz backhaul channel when wired backhaul is unavailable.
Each Nimbus mesh node covers roughly 140 square metres of indoor space.
A Nimbus mesh node add-on costs 89 dollars.
Nimbus mesh nodes are paired by pressing the sync button for 3 seconds.
The Nimbus companion app is available for iOS 16 or later and Android 12 or later.
The Nimbus app can create guest networks that expire after a configurable period of up to 72 hours.
Nimbus parental controls allow up to 20 device profiles per household.
The Nimbus app runs a built-in speed test against Larkspur Labs servers every 6 hours.
The Nimbus app is localised into 9 languages including Spanish, German and Japanese.
Nimbus Cloud Plus costs 4 dollars per month and adds 30 days of traffic history.
The free Nimbus Cloud tier keeps 7 days of traffic history.
Nimbus Cloud data is stored in the Frankfurt region for European customers.
Nimbus Cloud backs up router configuration automatically every 24 hours.
Nimbus Cloud Plus includes a WireGuard based remote access VPN with up to 5 simultaneous tunnels.
Larkspur Labs was founded in 2016 in Portland, Oregon.
Larkspur Labs is headquartered in Portland, Oregon with a second office in Dublin.
The chief executive of Larkspur Labs is Maren Oduya.
Larkspur Labs employs about 240 people as of 2024.
Larkspur Labs raised a 35 million dollar Series B in 2023.
The chief technology officer of Larkspur Labs is Teodor Vask.
Larkspur Labs is privately held and has no stock ticker.
Larkspur Labs support is available by chat from 8am to 8pm Pacific time on weekdays.
Phone support is included only with Nimbus Cloud Plus subscriptions.
Warranty replacements are shipped within 5 business days of an approved RMA.
A factory reset is performed by holding the reset pin for 10 seconds until the status light blinks amber.
Nimbus routers check for firmware updates nightly at 3am local time.
Nimbus 3 routers support WPA3 Personal and WPA2 mixed mode.
Larkspur Labs runs a bug bounty program with a top reward of 10000 dollars.
Firmware 3.2.1 fixed a buffer overflow in the Nimbus 3 UPnP service.
Nimbus routers use encrypted DNS over HTTPS by default.
Nimbus security logs are retained on the router for 14 days.
The latest Nimbus 3 firmware is version 3.4.0, released in October 2024.
Nimbus 3 firmware images are about 48 megabytes.
Nimbus 3 keeps the previous firmware image so a rollback takes under 2 minutes.
Beta firmware is distributed through the Nimbus Early Access channel in the app.
The Nimbus 3 router uses a quad core ARM processor clocked at 1.8 GHz.
The Nimbus 3 router has 1 gigabyte of RAM.
The Nimbus 3 router has 256 megabytes of flash storage.
The Nimbus 3 router draws 12 watts at peak load.
The Nimbus 3 router has a single USB 3.0 port for network storage.
The Nimbus 3 router has 6 internal antennas.
Nimbus products ship to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and the European Union.
